scope: D15-G architecture Go/No-Go over the D15-2..D15-5 native-continuity qualification. This contract decides GO/NO_GO for adoption readiness. It does not authorize a production cutover, does not accept or implement the Proposed ADR-0082/0083, does not open R3 and does not change the production DSH selector or default.

required_capabilities.name: root DSH session persistence and native reopen
required_capabilities.dsh_native_result: PASS (format migration + native persistence-layer reopen with one OS process per generation)
required_capabilities.byq_fallback: BYQ conversation rehydration when native resume is unavailable (unflushed session)

required_capabilities.name: adapter/DSH process restart and executor takeover resume
required_capabilities.dsh_native_result: PASS at the persistence seam; PASS at the isolated real-service boundary with a scripted keyless provider
required_capabilities.byq_fallback: BYQ lifecycle-journal rebuild + native attach/resume invocation; BYQ fallback only when native resume is unavailable

required_capabilities.name: host reboot resume (real runtime)
required_capabilities.dsh_native_result: NOT_RUN: D15-3 only models the host-reboot path at the persistence seam; no real host reboot was executed and a container/adapter restart is not a host reboot
required_capabilities.byq_fallback: none proven; native flock release plus attach/resume is expected but unqualified end to end

required_capabilities.name: native fork lineage continuity
required_capabilities.dsh_native_result: PASS in the evidence-only native harness (exact inherited cut, parent log immutable, contiguous child log)
required_capabilities.byq_fallback: BYQ must not persist subagent state itself; no BYQ fallback is built
required_capabilities.r_series_owner: R6 Full Runtime Continuity Qualification (native seam owned by DSH)

required_capabilities.name: continuable subagent resume (aggregate)
required_capabilities.dsh_native_result: BLOCKED: six required native scenarios PASS but child-crash and BYQ adapter-restart required items are BLOCKED
required_capabilities.byq_fallback: BYQ continues to use the foreground delegate path; no BYQ subagent persistence is added
required_capabilities.r_series_owner: R6/composition hookup (Proposed ADR-0082, not accepted, not implemented)

required_capabilities.name: subagent child-only crash recovery
required_capabilities.dsh_native_result: BLOCKED: the composed native spawn provider runs children in-process; no independent child SIGKILL while the parent stays alive
required_capabilities.byq_fallback: child-run-fault is supporting evidence only; it is not a substitute for child-crash
required_capabilities.r_series_owner: R6 (requires an out-of-process continuable child provider)

required_capabilities.name: BYQ adapter restart rebinding a continuable child
required_capabilities.dsh_native_result: BLOCKED: the committed byq_delegate_* composition never calls startContinuable(), and no committed BYQ surface cold-resumes a continuable child
required_capabilities.byq_fallback: none; the BYQ child-session projection/rebind contract does not exist
required_capabilities.r_series_owner: R6/composition hookup (Proposed ADR-0082, not accepted, not implemented)

required_capabilities.name: terminal I/O rebind across client-side faults
required_capabilities.dsh_native_result: PASS: page refresh, browser disconnect, frontend restart and gateway restart rebind the same attachment/PTY with no replay and no loss
required_capabilities.byq_fallback: BYQ owns TerminalAttachment identity/state/authorization/reconnect (evidence-only gate today)

required_capabilities.name: persistent terminal (aggregate)
required_capabilities.dsh_native_result: BLOCKED: four client rows PASS but adapter-restart and dsh-runtime-restart required rows are BLOCKED; native terminal sessions are process-local
required_capabilities.byq_fallback: no persisted TerminalAttachment or reconnect surface is composed
required_capabilities.r_series_owner: R4 TerminalAttachment (Proposed ADR-0083, not accepted, not implemented)

required_capabilities.name: terminal attachment rebind across a BYQ adapter restart
required_capabilities.dsh_native_result: BLOCKED: an adapter restart kills the DSH runtime; a fresh adapter rejects the old attachment
required_capabilities.byq_fallback: none; BYQ TerminalAttachment persistence/reconnect is absent
required_capabilities.r_series_owner: R4 TerminalAttachment (Proposed ADR-0083, not accepted, not implemented)

required_capabilities.name: terminal attachment rebind across a DSH runtime restart
required_capabilities.dsh_native_result: BLOCKED: a restarted DSH runtime is a new process and native terminal sessions do not survive it
required_capabilities.byq_fallback: none; requires the BYQ attachment layer plus an explicit lost/interrupted status
required_capabilities.r_series_owner: R4 TerminalAttachment (Proposed ADR-0083, not accepted, not implemented)

fail_closed: decision not in the decision vocabulary
missing or extra capability id (closed set)
a claimed capability status that differs from the independently derived status
a GO decision while any required capability is not PASS
a decision that differs from the independently derived verdict
a blocker set that does not equal the derived set of required non-PASS capabilities
a required capability claimed PASS without provenance-verified source evidence
a decision that declares its own coverage/verdict fields (self-declared)
GO does not authorize production cutover and must not be reported as cutover

notes.purpose: D15-G is a decision, not a qualification: a truthful NO_GO is the correct pass criterion. The observer fails (non-zero) when the decision is invalid, dishonest or aggregates a partial PASS into GO.
notes.go_boundary: GO would only mean DSH 0.1.5-rc.1 native continuity is adoption-ready; it would still not authorize a production cutover, which is a separate decision.
notes.r3: R3_RESUME stays NO regardless of this stage; R3 may only be reconsidered after a GO plus the R3/R6 native-continuity evidence.
